chunk_findings.detail: The change only adds an exemption declaring `ddflow_identify` to be MCP-only; it does not add a CLI `identify` command anywhere. The manifest’s other file is only `tests/test_cli_mcp_parity_reverse.py`, so there is no registration for `ddflow identify`. Therefore the stated regression test still fails: running `ddflow identify --help` still produces `argparse: invalid choice` and a non-zero exit. This does not fix the bug as specified.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/surfaces/exemptions.py:47

chunk_findings.detail: `ddflow list search` is added to the accepted `kind` choices, but the handler for `search` always prints an error and returns `REFUSED`. So `ddflow list search` still exits non-zero; MCP `ddflow_list` kind `search` still has no functioning CLI `list` counterpart. The fix requirement was to add the kind or make the help say it is MCP-only; advertising `search` as a valid `list` choice and then refusing it is neither, and the reported `ddflow list search` failure remains.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/surfaces/commands/viewers_lists.py:194

chunk_findings.detail: The change’s own stated regression test requires that `ddflow identify --help` exits 0, but this file never executes `run_cli(repo, "identify", "--help")`. The new blanket parity test can pass with a declaration like `Command(path=(), tool="ddflow_identify", reason="MCP-only")` in `surfaces/exemptions.py`, while `ddflow identify --help` still fails with argparse `invalid choice`. Thus the B-cli-mcp-parity-identify-list acceptance criterion for the `ddflow identify` surface is not actually verified.

chunk_findings.detail: In `cmd_list_any`, the new `--query` rejection is placed after `if a.kind in _OTHER_VIEWERS: return _other_viewer(a, c)`. `_OTHER_VIEWERS` includes `"session"`, so `ddflow list session --query "foo"` enters `_other_viewer`; because `_other_viewer` only special-cases `"search"`, it falls through to `cmd_session_list(a, c)` and exits 0 while silently ignoring the supplied query, instead of printing the new "session has no --query" error and returning `REFUSED`. Since `LIST_COMMAND` now advertises and accepts `--query` for all list kinds, this makes `list session --query` a silent no-op.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/surfaces/commands/viewers_lists.py:220

chunk_findings.detail: The change is required to regress both advertised fixes: `ddflow identify --help` exits 0 and `ddflow list session` is accepted. The added tests exercise `identify` and `list search`, but there is no `run_cli(repo, "list", "session")` call anywhere in this diff/change. If `viewers_lists.py` still omitted `session` from the accepted `list` kinds — the exact second half of B-cli-mcp-parity-identify-list — this suite would still pass, so the acceptance criterion for `ddflow list session` remains unverified, the same gap the earlier identify test finding identified for `identify`.

chunk_findings.detail: The new rejection guard uses truthiness: `if a.kind != "search" and getattr(a, "query", None):`. With input `ddflow list session --query ""`, argparse sets `a.query` to the empty string, which is falsy, so the guard does not reject it. Execution falls through to `_other_viewer(a, c)` and runs the session list, exiting 0 instead of printing the “session has no --query” error and returning `REFUSED`. This breaks the new “only `list search` takes --query” contract for an explicitly supplied empty query; the added test only exercises `--query "x"` and would not catch it.
